PassOkay

In App Store review (submitted Oct 19, 2026)

Solo designer & developer

Passport, visa, and ID photo app that checks your photo against the spec, entirely on your device.

You take or pick a photo, crop it to a document size, and get on-device checks for face, head size, centering, eyes, expression, tilt, lighting, and background. The photo never leaves the phone. A watermarked preview is free; one photo unlocks in HD for $4.99. The iPhone app uses React Native (Expo SDK 55) with native Swift Vision for the checks and StoreKit for the purchase. There's also a web version.

Stack

  • Expo / React Native
  • Swift (Vision)
  • StoreKit
  • Astro
  • Node
